bagPolicy.summary: The Hideout hasn't published bag policy details on its official site. Check your event page or contact the venue before you go.

parking.summary: There's plenty of free street parking in front of the Hideout on Wabansia and on nearby Ada and Throop streets. Lock your car and take valuables with you, since there have been break-ins nearby. Bike racks line Wabansia, and a Divvy station sits at Elston and Wabansia.
parking.quote: There is ample free street parking directly in front of the Hideout (on Wabansia)

rideshare.summary: Rideshare drivers can find the Hideout. Set your pickup to the venue's address on Wabansia Avenue.
rideshare.quote: You bet, Rideshares can find us.

concessions.summary: The Hideout doesn't serve food, but you're welcome to bring food in or order pizza delivery. The bar has non-alcoholic drinks like root beer, ginger beer, juice and NA beer. Cash and cards are accepted, and there's an ATM on site.
concessions.quote: You’re welcome to bring in food or order pizzas, etc.

accessibility.summary: The bar and performance room are on one level and wheelchair accessible by ramp, with a portable ramp for the two steps at the entrance. Priority reserved seating is available on request. Email manager@hideoutchicago.com with questions.
accessibility.quote: The Hideout bar and performance room are on one level and wheelchair accessible via ramp.

reEntry.summary: The Hideout hasn't published re-entry details on its official site. Check your event page or contact the venue before you go.

ticketPickup.summary: Fans under 21 can attend with a parent or guardian. Seating details are usually noted on each show's listing on the Hideout website.
ticketPickup.quote: We allow 21 yrs under with parents or guardian.

gates.summary: The Hideout opens at 5 PM Tuesday through Saturday, with earlier events on some days, so check the calendar for your show. Look for the Old Style sign on Wabansia to find the entrance.
gates.quote: 5pm – 1am but check the calendar for earlier events
